comments.author: Rebar Bot Nava
comments.body:
Root cause (proven 2026-10-30, worktree .rebar/worktrees/fix-test-isolation-jira-project, evidence .rebar/scratch/hammer-main/). The earlier cross-worker on-disk hypothesis is REFUTED: the failure is deterministic at collection time and needs no concurrency.

Observation: a probe plugin wrapping compose_operation_snapshot showed JIRA_PROJECT was UNSET in os.environ during every failing call, and JIRA_URL was the host's real value, not the conftest's example.atlassian.net. A pytest_runtest_call hook showed `_default_jira_project in item.fixturenames == False` for all 235 tests/unit/reconciler/orchestrate items on every worker (run2/call-*.jsonl). The 22 failures are just the subset that needs jira.project.

Minimal deterministic repro (collect-only, -n 0):
  pytest --co tests/unit/reconciler/test_lock_steal.py tests/unit/test_raw_git_write_lint.py tests/unit/reconciler/orchestrate/test_reconcile_once.py
  -> orchestrate items lack the reconciler conftest autouse fixtures (False 7). Dropping the middle arg, or replacing it with tests/interfaces/store, restores them (True 7).
Node identity check: that run builds TWO Package objects for tests/unit/reconciler (id 4444005424 for the first arg, 4445891376 for the third).

- Writer: pytest 9.1.1 Session.collect. A file argument directly under tests/unit (test_raw_git_write_lint.py or test_last_pass_backoff_jitter_paediatric.py) re-collects the tests/unit Dir with handle_dupes=False (_pytest/main.py:968), creating a fresh Package node for tests/unit/reconciler.
- Shared state: FixtureManager._pending_conftests (_pytest/fixtures.py:1789-1802). A conftest's fixtures are parsed once, bound to the FIRST Directory node object for its path, then popped.
- Reader: getfixtureinfo/_getautousenames for items under the second Package node finds no autouse names, so _default_jira_project and _sandbox_repo_root never run, and compose_operation_snapshot sees no JIRA_PROJECT.
Upstream: pytest-dev/pytest#14635 (dupes #14964, #14971, #15071), fixed by PR #14645 "deduplicate Directory nodes on re-collection", released in pytest 9.2.0 (2026-10-27, changelog entry #14635). Why serial runs and file pairs passed: none of those argument lists put a tests/unit-level file between two tests/unit/reconciler args.

Fix: pyproject dev extra pytest>=8,!=9.1.0,!=9.1.1 and uv.lock pytest 9.1.1 -> 9.2.0. Regression test tests/unit/test_pytest_interleaved_conftest_args.py rebuilds the argument shape in a throwaway project and runs the installed pytest.
Results:
- Regression test on pytest 9.1.1 (main lock): FAILED; inner run reported 'FAILED tests/unit/pkg/sub/test_second.py ... 1 failed, 2 passed'.
- Regression test on pytest 9.2.0 (fix): 1 passed.
- Observation's -n 4 command on main: 22 failed, 2100 passed (run1, run2). On the fix: exit 0, 2122 passed, 13 skipped (run4); the collect probe shows orchestrate True 235.
- make lint and make typecheck: pass. 17 related test files (nested-pytest, isolation, CI-parity, extras-parity, advisory): 262 passed.

Patch set 1 of Gerrit 3160 (pytest 9.2.0) got LLM-Review +1 but Verified -1 (run 41137997776). Both failures come from 9.2.0 itself, not from the #14635 fix:
1. 6 review-bot tests: AttributeError 'State' object has no attribute 'config'. Reproduced locally: on 9.1.1 the 3 test files pass (142 passed); on 9.2.0 3 fail. 9.2.0's MonkeyPatch.setattr records the old value from __dict__, so undo DELETES starlette State attributes (a 4-line script confirmed it: after undo, app.state.config is missing). Upstream pytest-dev/pytest#15099, still open.
2. Mutation gate, every shard: mutmut 3.7.0 crashes in its stats hook on item._nodeid, which 9.2.0 removed (boxed/mutmut#615, fixed in mutmut 3.8.1). Reproduced locally with scripts/mutation_gate.py run --shard signing.
Patch set 2 locks pytest 9.0.3 instead (newest release without #14635; constraint still excludes 9.1.0/9.1.1). On 9.0.3: regression test passes; orchestrate items keep the conftest fixtures (collect probe True 235); the Observation's -n 4 command plus the regression and review-bot tests: 2265 passed, 13 skipped, exit 0 (run5); full default-suite collection succeeds (20087 collected); local mutation gate gets past the stats phase (stats written, mutant testing started; stopped there to save host time). make lint passes.
Adopting 9.2.0 is filed as zodiacal-rockbound-egret (discovered_from this ticket); it needs the review-bot monkeypatch change or the upstream #15099 fix, and a measured mutmut upgrade.

compiled_state.description:
## Observation
On origin/main 38f8587f65d, `pytest -q -n 4` over tests/unit/reconciler/state, tests/unit/reconciler/test_lock_steal.py, tests/unit/reconciler/test_lock_orphan_local_ref.py, tests/unit/test_last_pass_backoff_jitter_paediatric.py, tests/unit/test_raw_git_write_lint.py, tests/scripts/graph/test_repair_pause_ownership.py, tests/interfaces/store, tests/interfaces/facades, tests/scripts/test_canary_status_refs_heldout.py and tests/unit/reconciler/orchestrate fails 22 reconcile tests (BackendEnvError 'empty Jira Cloud read scope' / ValueError 'inbound fetch requires a valid jira.project key'), reproduced 3 times. All failures are on one xdist worker. The same files run serially in that worker's order pass (697 passed), and each file paired alone with test_reconcile_once.py passes, so the failure depends on another worker running concurrently: shared on-disk state, not in-process leakage. Evidence is in the comments.

## Plan
1. Identify the cross-worker shared state: list files written outside tmp_path by the co-scheduled tests (e.g. run with a filesystem-write audit or compare the worktree before/after) and find what config resolution reads that drops the env-pinned JIRA_PROJECT=DIG.
2. Fix the source of the leak (the test or code writing shared state), not the victim; if the victim reads ambient config it should not, fix that read.
3. Add a regression test that runs the writer and the victim concurrently (or reproduces the shared write deterministically) and fails before the fix.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The writer, the shared file or state, and the reader are named on this ticket with the evidence (command and output).
- [ ] The -n 4 command in the Observation passes on the fix branch (verified by running it and recording the result on this ticket).
- [ ] A regression test fails on main and passes with the fix (verified by running it on both and recording both results).
- [ ] The Gerrit change is Verified +1.
